fields.text: Anna (sales): Revelis wants the CRM integration live by the end of January. Marco (client): we need the deal stage to update automatically after every call. Anna: we will send a proposal with the timeline by Friday. Marco: budget approval is expected next week.
key_points: Integration must be live by the end of January
Deal stage must update automatically after every call
Anna sends the proposal with the timeline by Friday

fields.text: Luca (support): the client reported that two meetings were not synchronised to HubSpot. Sara (dev): the webhook signature check failed because the secret was rotated. Luca: we must notify the client and re-send the two transcripts. Sara: I will add an alert when signature checks fail.
key_points: Two meetings were not synchronised to HubSpot
Cause: webhook signature check failed after a secret rotation
Notify the client and re-send the two transcripts
Sara adds an alert for failed signature checks

fields.text: Giulia (manager): kick-off meeting for the AutoCRM pilot with three sales reps. Paolo (sales): we want tasks created in HubSpot only after a human review. Giulia: the pilot lasts four weeks, with a check-in every Monday. Paolo: success means at least 80 percent of notes need no manual edits.
